result.summary: The main issue is a layout error at the bottom of the screen where a food item image (pizza) is clipped and improperly positioned over the navigation bar.

issues.description: The bottom pizza image container is incorrectly positioned, overlapping the content area and likely conflicting with the footer navigation layout.
